name: Redmi Note 5

images.credit: Zukunft, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Platform.Operating system: Original: Note 5: Android (operating system), Android Android Oreo, 8.1 "Oreo" with MIUI 9, Note 5 Pro: Android Nougat, Android 7.1.2 "Nougat" with MIUI 9Current:Note 5 (Global firmware)/Pro:Android Pie, Android 9 "Pie" with MIUI 12 / MIUI 11, Note 5 (Chinese firmware):Android Pie, Android 9 "Pie" with MIUI 12
Platform.CPU: Octa-core (4x 1.8 GHz Performance Kryo 260 cores based on Cortex A73 + 4x 1.6 GHz efficiency Kryo 260 cores based on Cortex A53)

Memory.RAM: Note 5: 3 or 4 GB RAM, Note 5 Pro: 4 or 6 LPDDR4X RAM
Memory.Storage: Note 5: 32 GB or 64 GB, Note 5 Pro: 32 GB or 64
Memory.Card slot: microSDXC, expandable up to 2 TB (uses SIM 2 slot)

Display.Display: 5.99 inches, 1080 x 2160 pixels, 18:9 ratio (403 ppi), IPS LCD capacitive touchscreen, 16M colors

Cameras.Rear camera: Note 5:, Dual: Samsung 12 MP (f/1.9, 1.25 μm) Dual-PD + Samsung 5 MP (f/2.0, 1.12 μm), Note 5 Pro:, Dual: Sony Exmor RS IMX486 12 MP (f/2.2, 1.25 μm) + Samsung S5K5E8 5 MP (f/2.0, 1.12 μm), phase detection autofocus, LED flash, Geo-tagging, touch focus, face detection, panorama, HDR
Cameras.Front camera: Note 5: OmniVision OV13855 13 MP 1.0 μm, Note 5 Pro: Sony Exmor RS IMX376 20 MP (f/2.2, 1/2.8", 1.0 μm), LED flash, 1080p

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11a/b/g/n/ac (2.4 & 5 GHz), dual-band, WiFi Direct, hotspot, Bluetooth V5, A2DP, Low-energy
